host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1
cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-gate -p athena-score -p athena-agent -p athena-context -p athena-git -p xtask -p athena-testkit --locked --no-fail-fast -q 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle a_blocked_job 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-core governed 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: git status --short | head; sed -n 195,210p athena.toml; wc -l crates/athena-core/src/slots.rs crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs crates/athena-core/src/state.rs; date
grep -n "^}\|^mod \|^#\[cfg(test)\]\|^    mod " crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs | grep -v "^.*:    mod" | head -30; wc -l crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs
cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --check && echo FMT_OK
